blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Full-day private excursion to the Argentine side of the falls with an English-speaking guide. The Ecological Jungle Train, viewpoints, Upper and Lower Circuits and the Devil’s Throat. Entrance fees for the main programme are included.

Optional Great Adventure at $100 per person: approximately 8 km through the jungle in an all-terrain vehicle along the Yacaratí trail to Puerto Macuco, followed by approximately 6 km along the Iguazú River in a semi-rigid boat. The exact disembarkation points and boat route depend on park operating conditions and are confirmed when booking. Overnight at a hotel in the Iguazú region.
